en.headline: Two mainland visitors arrested as unlicensed tour guides in Sai Kung and Central
en.dek: A man and a woman, both 31, were detained in a joint Immigration Department and Travel Industry Authority operation targeting illegal guiding services ahead of Golden Week.
body: A mainland man and woman have been arrested on suspicion of working as unlicensed tour guides in breach of their conditions of stay, the Travel Industry Authority said.

The authority conducted a joint operation with the Immigration Department on Monday and Tuesday targeting unlicensed guides at Sai Kung’s East Dam and in Central. Officers posed as customers to book services promoted on social media before making the arrests while the pair provided the services.

Both detainees are aged 31. The Immigration Department has charged them with breaching conditions of stay. The Travel Industry Authority is investigating possible breaches of the Travel Industry Ordinance and may press additional charges.

Anyone providing tour guide services without a valid licence faces a maximum fine of HK$50,000 and up to one year in prison. With the National Day Golden Week holiday approaching, the authority said it will step up joint inspections to protect visitors’ rights.

zh.headline: 旅監局聯同入境處拘兩名內地無牌導遊
zh.dek: 一男一女均31歲，分別在西貢東壩及中環被捕，涉嫌違反逗留條件提供導遊服務，國慶黃金周前加強執法。
body: 旅遊業監管局表示，聯同入境事務處在周一及周二展開聯合行動，打擊無牌導遊，於西貢萬宜水庫東壩及中環拘捕一男一女，兩人年齡均為31歲，涉嫌違反逗留條件在港從事導遊工作。
當局指，因應有人利用社交平台宣傳可在港提供導遊及攝影服務，人員以「放蛇」方式預訂服務，並在對方提供服務時拘捕他們。入境處已就違反逗留條件罪起訴二人。
旅監局正就二人涉嫌違反《旅遊業條例》及相關規定作進一步調查，不排除提出檢控。根據條例，無牌擔任導遊最高可被判罰款5萬元及監禁一年。
旅監局表示，國慶黃金周將至，會加強與其他部門聯合巡查，嚴格執行《旅遊業條例》，保障旅客權益。
